name: Piano montuno guajeo
desc: A syncopated salsa piano montuno in Bb major: octave-doubled arpeggios outline an I-vi-IV-V guajeo (Bb Gm Eb F) that changes every cycle, with rests carving the clave-locked syncopation. Slow filter bloom, ply fills at phrase ends; peak double-times with an off-eighth octave shimmer and a chunked hpf rotation.

code.sparse: note("<[~ bb3 ~ d4 f4 ~ d4 ~] [~ g3 ~ bb3 d4 ~ bb3 ~] [~ g3 ~ bb3 eb4 ~ bb3 ~] [~ a3 ~ c4 f4 ~ c4 ~]>").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.1).slow(16)).gain(${gain}*.9).room(${room}).orbit(4).play()
code.full: note("<[[bb3,bb4] d4 f4 [d5,d4] f4 d4 [bb4,bb3] f4] [[g3,g4] bb3 d4 [g4,g3] d4 bb3 [d4,d5] bb3] [[eb4,eb3] g4 bb3 [eb4,eb5] bb3 g4 [bb3,bb4] g4] [[f3,f4] a3 c4 [f4,f5] c4 a3 [c4,c5] a3]>").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.3).slow(16)).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[[bb3,bb4] d4 f4 [d5,d4] f4 d4 [bb4,bb3] f4] [[g3,g4] bb3 d4 [g4,g3] d4 bb3 [d4,d5] bb3] [[eb4,eb3] g4 bb3 [eb4,eb5] bb3 g4 [bb3,bb4] g4] [[f3,f4] a3 c4 [f4,f5] c4 a3 [c4,c5] a3]>").add(note(${root})).s("piano").clip(1).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.9, ${cut}*1.6).slow(8)).gain(${gain}).room(${room}).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(${gain}*.4).pan(.65)).chunk(4, x=>x.hpf(800)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(4).play()
